docs.title: PCL — Prompt Control Language
docs.text: A template language for orchestrating LLM agents: the template layer is PCL, the script layer is real Python.

docs.title: Why PCL?
docs.text:
• Zero lock-in: your logic is plain Python — import any library, use any tool
  • Readable & debuggable: .pcl compiles to readable Python source with line annotations (# pcl:N); tracebacks point back at your template
  • Full agent control: structured write-back, session context management, multi-round loops — all first-class language constructs
  • Zero dependencies: pure Python ≥3.10, nothing installed at runtime

docs.title: One-minute example
docs.text:
${ROUND = 0}
${DONE = False}
${W = ""}
${MAX = 100}

${:while ROUND < MAX}
    ${ROUND = ROUND + 1}

    ${:new}
    ${:pass :write W}
    Executor (round $(ROUND)/$(MAX)). Fresh context — everything you
    need is below.
    Task goal: $(prompt)
    Call pcl_write exactly once with: {"W": "one-line action summary"}

    ${:new}
    ${:pass :write W}
    Inspector (round $(ROUND)/$(MAX)). Fresh context — judge from the
    evidence below.
    Task goal: $(prompt)
    Call pcl_write exactly once with:
    {"W": {"done": true/false, "note": "one-line verdict"}}

    ${:if isinstance(W, dict) and W.get("done")}
        ${DONE = True}
        ${:break}
    ${:fi}
${:done}

${:if DONE}
$(# 🎉 Goal achieved in round $(ROUND)/$(MAX)#)
${:fi}

pcl run goal.pcl "Create hello.txt with content Hello PCL"

docs.title: CLI Manual
docs.text: Command pcl (distribution pclang); python -m pcl equivalent.

docs.title: pcl run
docs.text:
pcl run <file.pcl> [PROMPT…] [options]
Option Description --agent NAME pi (default, real agent) / null (reply=prompt, debugging) / script (JSONL replay) -o FILE write the output document to FILE (default stdout) --trace streaming stderr diagnostics: pass submissions, thinking deltas, pcl_write, turn boundaries --cache none\|dir cache policy (default per settings) --pi-bin PATH / --pi-arg ARG pi executable & pass-through args (repeatable) --script-path FILE script-bridge replay file --timeout SEC per-pass timeout

Positional arguments become the template's prompt variable (space-joined).

docs.text:

docs.text:
• Location: $XDG_CACHE_HOME/pcl (default ~/.cache/pcl)

docs.text:
pcl gen file.pcl | less          # inspect generated code
pcl run --agent null file.pcl    # template logic without an agent
pcl run --trace file.pcl 2>trace.log   # full trace

docs.title: Examples tour
docs.text:
All in examples/, executable (shebang + chmod +x).

Run with pcl run <file.pcl> "<prompt>" (default --agent pi, model required; connector install in the Quickstart). Add --agent null for pure template debugging.

docs.title: goal-loop — Goal-achievement loop
docs.text:
./goal-loop.pcl "Create a file named hello.txt with content Hello PCL"

/goal-style: every pass (act/check) gets a fresh context (:new) with a self-contained prompt (goal + history + round); the :if condition evaluates after writeback — break when done.

docs.title: review-prove — Review-and-prove loop
docs.text:
./review-prove.pcl "Remote work is better than office work" --trace

Refines viewpoints until all credible. Shows: :while + :break, structured write-back (dict), cross-round state, :new isolation, $(# … #) final notes.

docs.title: plan-review — Plan self-scoring loop
docs.text:
./plan-review.pcl "Plan a quarterly tech sharing session"

Draft → score loop until 10/10 (or round cap). Shows: threshold loops, integer write-back validation.

docs.title: data-analysis — Structured data fetch
docs.text:
./data-analysis.pcl

Python-side data; the agent fetches via pcl_read on demand. Shows: :read snapshots.

docs.title: context-session — Context continuation
docs.text:
./context-session.pcl

:save → :new → :load roundtrip with session-memory verification.

docs.title: use-library — Template library reuse
docs.text:
./use-library.pcl --agent null

.pcl-to-.pcl imports, cross-file template functions. Shows: the load layer (imports never trigger the agent).

docs.title: hello — Shebang executable
docs.text:
./hello.pcl "Quantum entanglement"

Minimal #!/usr/bin/env pcl + chmod +x example.

docs.title: R406 (unauthorized write) mid-run?
docs.text:
The agent wrote names not declared via :write. Two cases:

  1. A fully flat dict ({"done": true}) gets auto-wrapped when all keys are unauthorized — the error means it was a mix (authorized
  2. others)
  3. State the format explicitly in the prompt: "call pcl_write exactly once with {"W": {...}}" (nested under the authorized name), plus "do not call it again afterwards"

docs.title: ${X = W.get(...)} inside a pass sees a stale value?
docs.text: The pass body renders before the commit — the write-back hasn't happened yet. Put post-processing outside the pass body, past the next directive (e.g. after ${:new}/${:if}), or use a :if condition expression (evaluated post-writeback). See Guide · post-writeback processing.

docs.title: C305: comment must be alone?
docs.text: ${:# …} is line-delimited and needs its own line (indentation ok). For inline remarks use plain Python: ${_ = None # note}.

docs.title: No agent / no model — how do I debug?
docs.text:
pcl run --agent null file.pcl "test"   # reply = prompt verbatim

All template logic (interpolation, loops, branches) still runs.

docs.title: See the generated Python?
docs.text:
pcl gen file.pcl

Readable source with # pcl:N line annotations; error tracebacks map back to template lines too.

docs.title: The agent seems to "forget" after :new?
docs.text: :new starts a fresh session — all history cleared (including $(@ @) injections). Feature, not bug: post-:new prompts must be self-contained. Drop :new to keep history.

docs.title: What is $(prompt)?
docs.text: The first positional argument: pcl run x.pcl "task" → prompt = "task". Bare sugar $(prompt) ≡ $(prompt); default "".

docs.title: Dicts print as JSON in output?
docs.text: text() rules: dict/list/tuple → compact JSON (ensure_ascii=False), None → null, bool → true/false. Custom formats: json.dumps(..., indent=2) yourself.

docs.title: What does :new do in embedded runs (/pcl run)?
docs.text: It switches your current pi session (the old one auto-persists). Takeover rules guard this: auto-follow, binding degradation A523, cross-cwd rejection. See RFC 0002 §7.

docs.title: Exit codes 1/2/3?
docs.text: 1 = compile-time (L/P/C), 2 = runtime (R), 3 = bridge (A), 130 = interrupt. Full table in the Language Reference.

docs.title: How do I contribute a feature?
docs.text: Write an RFC first — see CONTRIBUTING.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: Concepts and patterns for users. Normative definitions: RFC 0000.

docs.title: The two-layer model
docs.text:
• Template layer: text + ${…} constructs — a "prompt template with control flow"
  • Script layer: real Python inside ${…}/$(…) — expressions, assignments, imports, stdlib, third-party libraries, all native

A program's product = output document (stdout or -o file) + side effects (agent interaction, context switches).

docs.title: Interpolation dual forms
Pass: one agent interaction
docs.text:
${:pass :read MY_VAR :write RESULT}
<prompt body — any mix of text and interpolation>

Lifecycle:

  1. Render: the prompt body renders into an isolated buffer (never the output document)
  2. Commit: auto-commits at the next directive or EOF (trimmed)
  3. Wait: the agent finishes the turn; meanwhile it may read the snapshot via pcl_read and write via pcl_write
  4. Write-back: :write-declared variables get assigned; the reply goes to the output document and the variable reply

Key points:

  • :read X — freezes a snapshot of X at pass start for the agent
  • :write X — the sole authorized name. A flat dict from the agent ({"done": true} instead of {"X": {...}}) is auto-wrapped; mixing authorized + unauthorized names → R406
  • An empty prompt skips the bridge entirely
  • ${} inside a pass body executes before the commit — to process the result, place statements outside the pass body, past the next directive (below)

docs.title: Post-writeback processing: the directive boundary
docs.text:
A pass body ends at the next directive. Written values exist only after the commit, so post-processing must sit after a directive:

${:pass :write W}
Executor: … write {"W": "action summary"}

${:new}
${HISTORY = HISTORY + (W if isinstance(W, str) else str(W)) + "\n"}  ← after :new = past the directive boundary; W is Pass 1's write-back
${:pass :write W}
Inspector: actions so far: $(HISTORY)… write {"W": {"done": true/false}}
${:if isinstance(W, dict) and W.get("done")}    ← :if condition evaluates after writeback
    ${:break}
${:fi}

Two correct places to read a written value: pure statements after the next directive (e.g. between Pass 2's ${:new} and ${:pass} — placing them inside the previous pass body is a common error and reads the stale pre-commit value), or a directive's condition expression (evaluated post-writeback).

docs.title: Context management: :new / :save / :load
docs.text:
Directive Effect ${:new} Fresh session — all history cleared (the agent sees nothing prior) ${:save name} Persist the session; name = opaque token ${:load name} Switch back to the saved session
  • After :new, pass prompts must be self-contained (goal, history, round number spelled out)
  • Token persistence across runs is your business: ${open("ctx.txt","w").write(TOKEN)}

docs.title: Pattern: the goal loop
docs.text:
Act + check per round, stop when done (full runnable version: examples/goal-loop.pcl):

${:while ROUND < MAX}
    ${ROUND = ROUND + 1}
    ${:new}
    ${:pass :write W}        ← Pass 1: act (self-contained prompt)
    ${HISTORY = HISTORY + W + "\n"}   ← after a directive: reads Pass 1's write-back
    ${:new}
    ${:pass :write W}        ← Pass 2: check
    ${:if isinstance(W, dict) and W.get("done")}
        ${DONE = True}
        ${:break}
    ${:fi}
${:done}

docs.title: Notes and context injection
docs.text:
Construct Destination Typical use $(# … #) note standalone → output doc; embedded → in-session entry (never enters LLM context) round progress, final verdicts $(@ … @) context injection standalone user message into the agent session (no inference triggered) goal declarations, background material

Both are full template bodies — ${}/$()/directives work inside. When the body contains a literal delimiter, use the extended form: $(end# … #end), $(tag@ … @tag).

docs.title: Directive cheat sheet
docs.text: Directive Effect ${:if}/${:elif}/${:else}/${:fi} conditionals ${:while …}${:done} / ${:for X in …}${:done} loops ${:break} / ${:continue} loop control ${:function f(x)}…${:endfunction} / ${:return} functions ${:pass [:read X] [:write Y]} agent interaction ${:save T} / ${:load T} / ${:new} context ${:# comment} / ${# comment} comments (own line only)

docs.title: Two pi integrations
docs.text:
Forward (terminal) — pcl run --agent pi file.pcl: PCL spawns a headless pi --mode rpc in its own session, runs to completion, exits. Good for scripting / CI / one-shot tasks.

Embedded (inside a pi session) — in the pi conversation you're already using:

/pcl run /path/to/goal.pcl "task description"
  • Passes go straight into your current session — the agent sees your conversation context
  • Output goes to a temp file; $(# … #) notes appear as session entries that scroll with the chat (never entering LLM context)
  • :new/:load inside the script switch the session you're looking at (guarded by takeover rules, see RFC 0002 §7)
  • Other subcommands: /pcl gen|check|config|version mirror the CLI

~/.pcl/bin/ quick commands — drop executable .pcl scripts into that directory; the connector scans recursively and registers them as slash commands: paths flatten into command names (tools/review → /pcl-tools-review), always embedded in the current session (never spawned):

mkdir -p ~/.pcl/bin
cp examples/goal-loop.pcl ~/.pcl/bin/goal.pcl
chmod +x ~/.pcl/bin/goal.pcl
# restart pi, then:
/pcl-goal "Create hello.txt with content Hello PCL"

Scripts in ~/.pcl/bin/ execute inside your session — only place templates from sources you trust (equivalent to handing an arbitrary prompt to the agent; see SECURITY.md).

docs.title: Language Reference (cheat sheet)
docs.text: User-facing quick reference. Full normative spec: RFC 0000.

docs.title: Constructs
docs.text:
Construct Syntax One-liner Initiator interpolation ${STMTS} real Python statements; expression values inserted; 1:1 line numbers Merged interpolation $(STMTS) same, but woven into the merged segment; good for splicing Directive ${:verb …} control flow / context / pass Comment ${:# …} / ${# …} discarded to EOL; own line only Note $(# … #) rendered via note() — never enters LLM context Context injection $(@ … @) standalone user message into the session — no inference Escape $$ literal $

Extended delimiters: $(end# body containing #) literal #end) — opening <delim>#, closing #<delim>) strictly symmetric; a missing closing falls back to a plain $() expression.

docs.title: Closing rules
docs.text:
• ${…} closes on }, $(…) on ) — bracket-balanced, string/comment aware
  • Constructs may span lines inside triple-quoted strings; directives are always single-line

docs.title: Behavior rules
docs.text:
• Line elimination: if every construct on a line produces no output, the whole line is removed (directives, pure statements, comments, $(@ @) lines); note lines are not eliminated; blank lines kept
  • text() output: str as-is; None→null; bool→true/false; dict/list/tuple→compact JSON; else str(v)
  • Reserved names (binding → C300): emit text submit save load new_ctx push_sink pop_sink note context; function names main prompt reply; the __pcl_ prefix

docs.title: Pass
docs.text:
${:pass :read snapshot :write result}
  • Prompt body runs to the next directive; auto-commit (trimmed)
  • :write auto-wrap: sole authorized name + fully flat agent dict → nested
  • Empty prompt skips; empty reply A504; unauthorized writes R406; write-back depth ≤ 32

docs.title: Error codes
docs.text:
Class Typical Exit Meaning L L100–L102 1 lexical P P200–P203 1 parse C C300/C305/C310 1 compile constraints R R400/R406/R430 2 runtime A A500–A523 3 bridge SIGINT R409 130 interrupt

Common: C305 comment not alone on its line; C300 bound a reserved name; R406 agent wrote an unauthorized name; A504 agent produced no valid reply; R430 :load session file missing.

docs.title: Quickstart
docs.text: Five minutes: install → first template → watch the agent write back a variable.

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
pip install pclang        # PEP 668 systems (Arch/conda…): uv tool install pclang / pipx install pclang

Python ≥ 3.10. pclang is the distribution name; the command and import name is pcl.

docs.title: First template (no agent)
docs.text:
Create hello.pcl:

${NAME = prompt or "world"}

Hello, $(NAME)!
Today is ${import datetime; datetime.date.today().isoformat()}.

Run:

pcl run hello.pcl "PCL"

Output:

Hello, PCL!
Today is 2026-09-17.

You just used PCL's core ideas:

  • ${…} holds real Python statements (assignments, imports, anything)
  • $(…) weaves an expression's value into the text
  • $(prompt) is the first positional argument (pcl run x.pcl "task" → prompt = "task")

docs.title: Add an agent: one pass
docs.text:
Prerequisite: pi installed with a model configured. Create score.pcl:

${SCORE = 0}

${:pass :write SCORE}
Write one sentence about the topic, then call pcl_write with your
self-rated quality score (0-10 integer) written to SCORE:
$(prompt)

${:if SCORE >= 7}
✔ Quality passed ($(SCORE))
${:else}
✘ Score too low ($(SCORE))
${:fi}

Run:

pcl run score.pcl "Why is the sky blue"

What happened:

  1. ${:pass :write SCORE} sends the text below to the agent (pi)
  2. The agent calls the pcl_write tool to write SCORE
  3. PCL continues with the written value — ${:if SCORE >= 7} is just a Python conditional

Debugging without an agent:

pcl run --agent null score.pcl "test"   # reply = prompt verbatim

docs.title: Shebang execution
docs.text:
echo '#!/usr/bin/env pcl' | cat - score.pcl > score2.pcl
chmod +x score2.pcl
./score2.pcl "Why is grass green"

docs.title: Running inside a pi session
docs.text:
With the connector installed (pi install npm:pcl-connector-pi), you never leave the conversation:

/pcl run ./score.pcl "Why is the sky blue"

~/.pcl/bin/ quick commands — executable .pcl files dropped there become slash commands automatically:

mkdir -p ~/.pcl/bin && cp score.pcl ~/.pcl/bin/
chmod +x ~/.pcl/bin/score.pcl
# after restarting pi: /pcl-score "Why is the sky blue"

See Guide · two pi integrations.

docs.title: Settings
docs.text: For users. Full rules (trust model, merge algorithm): RFC 0001 §8.

docs.title: Two layers
docs.text:
Layer Path Purpose User ~/.config/pcl/settings.json (or $PCL_CONFIG_FILE) your environment Project nearest .pcl/settings.json walking up from the entry .pcl shipped with a repo

Precedence: CLI > project > user > built-in defaults. Format is JSONC (// comments and trailing commas allowed).

docs.title: Common configuration
docs.text:
{
  // bridge: pi / null / script
  "agent": "pi",
  // per-pass timeout (seconds)
  "timeout": 900,
  // default --trace
  "trace": false,
  "cache": {
    "disable": false,       // true = recompile every time
    "dir": null,            // custom cache dir (relative to the settings file)
    "keep_per_stem": 2
  }
}

User-level only (an error if present at project level):

{
  "pi": {
    "bin": "/usr/local/bin/pi",
    "connector_path": "~/pi/pcl-connector/pi",
    "args": ["--model", "glm-5.3"]   // concatenated across layers
  },
  "script": { "path": "replay.jsonl" }
}

Why the restriction? A project file is untrusted input you get by cloning — letting it name executables/extensions would let a repo silently run arbitrary code. Behavioral knobs (agent/timeout/trace/ cache) are project-safe; executable surfaces (pi.bin etc.) are not.

docs.title: Inspecting effective config
docs.text:
pcl config            # per-key values + source (CLI/project/user/built-in)
pcl config --defaults

docs.title: Environment variables
docs.text: Variable Effect PCL_CONFIG_FILE redirect the user-level file PCL_NO_PROJECT_CONFIG ignore project settings (sealed run) PCL_BIN used by the connector to spawn pcl in embedded mode

docs.title: PCL — Prompt Control Language
docs.text: 编排 LLM agent 的模板语言：模板层是 PCL，脚本层是真 Python。

docs.title: 为什么选 PCL？
docs.text:
• 零锁定：你的逻辑就是普通 Python——import 任何库、用任何工具
  • 可读可调试：.pcl 编译为带行号标注的可读 Python 源（# pcl:N），traceback 直指模板行
  • 完整的 agent 控制：结构化写回、会话上下文管理、多轮循环——都是一等语言构造
  • 零依赖：纯 Python ≥3.10，运行时不装任何第三方包

docs.title: 一分钟看懂
docs.text:
${ROUND = 0}
${DONE = False}
${W = ""}
${MAX = 100}

${:while ROUND < MAX}
    ${ROUND = ROUND + 1}

    ${:new}
    ${:pass :write W}
    执行者（第 $(ROUND)/$(MAX) 轮）。新上下文——所需信息如下。
    任务目标：$(prompt)
    只调用一次 pcl_write 写入：{"W": "行动摘要"}

    ${:new}
    ${:pass :write W}
    检查者（第 $(ROUND)/$(MAX) 轮）。新上下文——依以下证据判断。
    任务目标：$(prompt)
    只调用一次 pcl_write 写入：{"W": {"done": true/false, "note": "理由"}}

    ${:if isinstance(W, dict) and W.get("done")}
        ${DONE = True}
        ${:break}
    ${:fi}
${:done}

${:if DONE}
$(# 🎉 目标在第 $(ROUND)/$(MAX) 轮达成#)
${:fi}

pcl run goal.pcl "创建 hello.txt，内容为 Hello PCL"

docs.text:
./goal-loop.pcl "Create a file named hello.txt with content Hello PCL"

/goal 式：每 pass（执行/检查）开新上下文（:new），prompt 自包含 （目标 + 累积历史 + 轮次）；:if 条件在写回后求值——达成即 :break。

docs.title: review-prove — 审查自证循环
docs.text:
./review-prove.pcl "Remote work is better than office work" --trace

多轮审查观点直到全部可信。展示：:while + :break、结构化写回 （dict）、跨轮状态、:new 隔离、$(# … #) 注记终态。

docs.title: plan-review — 方案自评循环
docs.text:
./plan-review.pcl "Plan a quarterly tech sharing session"

方案制作 → 打分循环直到 10/10（或轮次上限）。展示：阈值循环、 整数写回校验。

docs.title: data-analysis — 结构化数据拉取
docs.text:
./data-analysis.pcl

Python 侧造数，agent 经 pcl_read 按需取数（不拼进 prompt）。 展示：:read 快照。

docs.title: context-session — 上下文接续
docs.text:
./context-session.pcl

:save → :new → :load 往返，验证会话记忆。

docs.title: use-library — 模板库复用
docs.text:
./use-library.pcl --agent null

.pcl 间 import、模板函数跨文件调用。展示：加载层 （import 永不触发 agent）。

docs.title: hello — shebang 直执行
docs.text:
./hello.pcl "Quantum entanglement"

#!/usr/bin/env pcl + chmod +x 的最小示例。

docs.location: zh/faq/#模板执行到一半报-R406越权写入
docs.title: 模板执行到一半报 R406（越权写入）？
docs.text:
agent 写了 :write 没声明的名字。两种可能：

  1. agent 平铺写 dict（{"done": true}）——若全部键越权会自动包装， 不报错；报错说明是混写（授权名 + 其他名都有）
  2. 提示词里明确写："只调用一次 pcl_write，写入 {"W": {...}}" （嵌套到授权名下），并加一句"之后不要再调用"

docs.title: pass 里写的 ${X = W.get(...)} 拿到的是旧值？
docs.text: pass 体在提交之前渲染——此时写回还没发生。把后处理语句放到 pass 之后的指令边界外（如 ${:new}/${:if} 之后），或直接用 :if 条件表达式（在写回后求值）。见 核心指南 · 写回后处理。

docs.title: C305 注释必须独占一行？
docs.text: ${:# …} 是行界定注释，独占一行（允许缩进）。要在行内标注用 纯 Python：${_ = None # 说明}。

docs.location: zh/faq/#没有-agent--没配模型怎么调试
docs.title: 没有 agent / 没配模型怎么调试？
docs.text:
pcl run --agent null file.pcl "测试"   # reply = prompt 原样，不调 LLM

模板逻辑（插值、循环、分支）全部照常执行。

docs.title: 想看生成了什么 Python？
docs.text:
pcl gen file.pcl

输出带 # pcl:N 行号标注的可读源码；报错时 traceback 也回指模板行。

docs.title: :new 之后 agent 好像"失忆"了？
docs.text: :new 开新会话，清空全部历史（包括 $(@ @) 注入的上下文）。 这是特性不是 bug——新上下文里的 pass prompt 必须自包含（目标、 历史、轮次都要写进去）。想保留历史就去掉 :new。

docs.title: $(prompt) 是什么？
docs.text: 模板收到的第一个位置参数。pcl run x.pcl "任务" → prompt = "任务"。 裸糖 $(prompt) ≡ $(prompt)；缺省 ""。

docs.title: 输出里 dict 变成了 JSON？
docs.text: text() 规则：dict/list/tuple → 紧凑 JSON（ensure_ascii=False）， None → null，bool → true/false。要自定义格式自己 json.dumps(..., indent=2)。

docs.title: 嵌入运行（/pcl run）里 :new 会怎样？
docs.text: 会切换你当前的 pi 会话（旧会话自动落盘）。有接管规则保护： auto-follow、绑定降级 A523、跨 cwd 拒绝。详见 RFC 0002 §7。

docs.title: 退出码 1/2/3 分别是什么？
docs.text: 1 = 编译期（L/P/C），2 = 运行期（R），3 = 桥接（A），130 = 中断。 完整错误码表见 语言参考。

docs.title: 如何贡献新特性？
docs.text: 先写 RFC——见 CONTRIBUTING。

docs.title: 核心指南
docs.text: 面向使用者的概念与模式。规范性定义见 RFC 0000。

docs.title: 双层模型
docs.text:
• 模板层：文本 + ${…} 构造。你写的是"带控制流的提示词模板"
  • 脚本层：${…} 和 $(…) 里是真 Python——表达式、赋值、import、 标准库、第三方库，全部原生

产物 = 输出文档（stdout 或 -o 文件）+ 副作用（agent 交互、上下文切换）。

docs.title: 插值双形式
pass：与 agent 的一次交互
docs.text:
${:pass :read MY_VAR :write RESULT}
<prompt 文本——可以是文本与插值的任意组合>

生命周期：

  1. 渲染：prompt 体渲染到独立缓冲（不进输出文档）
  2. 提交：遇到下一个指令或文件结尾自动提交（内部去首尾空白）
  3. 等待：agent 完成本轮；期间可用 pcl_read 读快照、pcl_write 写回
  4. 写回：:write 声明的变量被赋值；reply 同时写入输出文档和变量 reply

要点：

  • :read X——pass 开始时冻结 X 的快照给 agent 看（防渲染后变动）
  • :write X——唯一授权名。agent 平铺写 dict（如 {"done": true} 而非 {"X": {...}}）会自动包装；混写授权名+其他名 → R406
  • 空 prompt 直接跳过（不调 agent）
  • pass 体内的 ${} 会先执行再提交——想在写回后处理结果，把语句放到 pass 之后的指令边界外（见下）

docs.title: 写回后处理：指令边界
docs.text:
pass 体结束于下一个指令。写回值只在提交后存在，所以后处理语句 必须放在指令之后：

${:pass :write W}
执行者：…… 写入 {"W": "行动摘要"}

${:new}
${HISTORY = HISTORY + (W if isinstance(W, str) else str(W)) + "\n"}   ← :new 之后 = 指令边界外，W 已是 Pass 1 写回值
${:pass :write W}
检查者：已有行动：$(HISTORY)…… 写入 {"W": {"done": true/false}}
${:if isinstance(W, dict) and W.get("done")}    ← :if 条件在写回之后求值
    ${:break}
${:fi}

两种读写回值的正确位置：下一个指令之后的纯语句（如 Pass 2 的 ${:new} 与 ${:pass} 之间——夹在前一 pass 体与指令之间是常见错误，读到的是提交前的旧值）， 或 :if 等指令的条件表达式（在写回后求值）。

docs.title: 上下文管理：:new / :save / :load
docs.text:
指令 作用 ${:new} 开新会话——清空全部历史（agent 看不到之前发生了什么） ${:save 名} 保存当前会话，名 = opaque token ${:load 名} 切回保存的会话
  • :new 后的 pass prompt 必须自包含（目标、历史、轮次都要写进去）
  • token 跨运行持久化自己管：${open("ctx.txt","w").write(TOKEN)}

docs.title: 模式：goal 达成循环
docs.text:
每轮执行+检查、达成即停（完整可运行版见 examples/goal-loop.pcl）：

${:while ROUND < MAX}
    ${ROUND = ROUND + 1}
    ${:new}
    ${:pass :write W}        ← Pass 1：执行（prompt 自包含）
    ${HISTORY = HISTORY + W + "\n"}   ← 指令后：读 Pass 1 写回值
    ${:new}
    ${:pass :write W}        ← Pass 2：检查
    ${:if isinstance(W, dict) and W.get("done")}
        ${DONE = True}
        ${:break}
    ${:fi}
${:done}

docs.title: 注记与上下文注入
docs.text:
构造 去向 典型用途 $(# … #) 注记 独立运行 → 输出文档；嵌入运行 → 会话内条目（不进 LLM 上下文） 轮次进度、终态结论 $(@ … @) 上下文注入 作为独立用户消息进 agent 会话（不触发推理） 任务目标声明、背景资料

两者都是完整模板体——内部可以再用 ${}/$()/指令。内容里出现定界符 字面时用扩展形式：$(end# … #end)、$(tag@ … @tag)。

docs.title: 指令速查
docs.text: 指令 作用 ${:if}/${:elif}/${:else}/${:fi} 条件 ${:while …}${:done} / ${:for X in …}${:done} 循环 ${:break} / ${:continue} 跳出/继续 ${:function f(x)}…${:endfunction} / ${:return} 函数 ${:pass [:read X] [:write Y]} agent 交互 ${:save T} / ${:load T} / ${:new} 上下文 ${:# 注释} / ${# 注释} 注释（须独占一行）

docs.title: 与 pi 的两种集成
docs.text:
正向（终端）——pcl run --agent pi file.pcl：PCL 拉起 headless 的 pi --mode rpc，用独立会话跑完即退。适合脚本化/CI/一次性任务。

嵌入（pi 会话内）——在你正在用的 pi 对话里：

/pcl run /path/to/goal.pcl "任务描述"
  • pass 直接进你当前的会话——agent 看得到你们的对话上下文
  • 输出写临时文件、注记 $(# … #) 以会话条目形式随对话滚动（不进 LLM 上下文）
  • 脚本里的 :new/:load 会切换你眼前的会话（有接管规则保护，见 RFC 0002 §7）
  • 其余子命令：/pcl gen|check|config|version 与 CLI 同义

~/.pcl/bin/ 快捷命令——把可执行 .pcl 脚本放进该目录，连接器 递归扫描并自动注册为斜杠命令：路径展平为命令名（tools/review → /pcl-tools-review），一律嵌入当前会话运行（从不另起进程）：

mkdir -p ~/.pcl/bin
cp examples/goal-loop.pcl ~/.pcl/bin/goal.pcl
chmod +x ~/.pcl/bin/goal.pcl
# 重启 pi 后：
/pcl-goal "在当前目录创建 hello.txt，内容为 Hello PCL"

~/.pcl/bin/ 里的脚本会在你的会话内执行——只放你信任来源的模板 （等同把任意 prompt 交给 agent；见 SECURITY.md）。

docs.title: 语言参考（速查）
docs.text: 面向使用者的速查表。完整规范：RFC 0000。

docs.title: 构造
docs.text:
构造 语法 一句话语义 发起型插值 ${STMTS} 真 Python 语句；表达式值插入输出；行号 1:1 合并型插值 $(STMTS) 同上但织入合并段；适合同行拼值 指令 ${:动词 …} 控制流/上下文/pass 注释 ${:# …} / ${# …} 至行尾丢弃；须独占一行 注记 $(# … #) 渲染后经 note 下发——不进 LLM 上下文 上下文注入 $(@ … @) 独立用户消息进会话——不触发推理 转义 $$ 字面 $

扩展定界符：$(end# 内容含 #) 字面 #end)——开头 <delim>#、 结尾 #<delim>) 严格对称；闭合不存在则回落为普通 $()。

docs.title: 闭合规则
docs.text:
• ${…} 按 }、$(…) 按 )——括号配平、字符串/注释感知
  • 三引号字符串内可跨行；指令一律单行

docs.title: 行为规则
docs.text:
• 独行消除：行内全部构造无输出 → 整行移除（指令、纯语句、注释、 $(@ @) 行）；注记行不消除；空行保留
  • text() 输出：str 原样；None→null；bool→true/false； dict/list/tuple→紧凑 JSON；其他 str(v)
  • 保留名（绑定即 C300）：emit text submit save load new_ctx push_sink pop_sink note context；函数名 main prompt reply； __pcl_ 前缀

docs.title: pass
docs.text:
${:pass :read 快照名 :write 写回名}
  • prompt 体至下一个指令；自动提交（trim）
  • :write 自动包装：唯一授权名 + agent 全平铺 → 嵌套
  • 空 prompt 跳过；空回复 A504；越权写 R406；写回深度 ≤32

docs.title: 错误码速查
docs.text:
类 典型码 退出码 含义 L L100–L102 1 词法 P P200–P203 1 解析 C C300/C305/C310 1 编译约束 R R400/R406/R430 2 运行期 A A500–A523 3 桥接 SIGINT R409 130 中断

常见：C305 注释没独占一行；C300 绑定了保留名；R406 agent 写了未授权名；A504 agent 无有效回复；R430 :load 的会话文件不存在。

docs.title: 快速开始
docs.text: 5 分钟：安装 → 写第一个模板 → 看 agent 写回变量。

docs.title: 安装
docs.text:
pip install pclang        # PEP 668 环境（Arch/conda…）：uv tool install pclang / pipx install pclang

要求 Python ≥ 3.10。pclang 是分发名，命令与 import 名都是 pcl。

docs.title: 第一个模板（无 agent）
docs.text:
新建 hello.pcl：

${NAME = prompt or "世界"}

你好，$(NAME)！
现在是 ${import datetime; datetime.date.today().isoformat()}。

运行：

pcl run hello.pcl "PCL"

输出：

你好，PCL！
现在是2026-09-17。

这里你已经用到了 PCL 的核心思想：

  • ${…} 里是真 Python 语句（赋值、import 都行）
  • $(…) 把 Python 表达式的值织入文本
  • $(prompt) 是模板收到的第一个位置参数（pcl run x.pcl "任务" → prompt = "任务"）

docs.title: 加上 agent：一个 pass
docs.text:
前提：安装了 pi 并配置好模型。新建 score.pcl：

${SCORE = 0}

${:pass :write SCORE}
请就以下主题写一句话，并把自评质量分（0-10 整数）调用 pcl_write 写入 SCORE：
$(prompt)

${:if SCORE >= 7}
✔ 质量达标（$(SCORE) 分）
${:else}
✘ 分数不够（$(SCORE) 分）
${:fi}

运行：

pcl run score.pcl "为什么天是蓝的"

发生了什么：

  1. ${:pass :write SCORE} 把下面的文本发给 agent（pi）
  2. agent 调用 pcl_write 工具写回 SCORE
  3. PCL 拿到写回值继续执行——${:if SCORE >= 7} 就是普通 Python 条件

没有 agent 也能调试：

pcl run --agent null score.pcl "测试"    # reply=prompt 原样，纯模板逻辑验证

docs.title: shebang 直执行
docs.text:
echo '#!/usr/bin/env pcl' | cat - score.pcl > score2.pcl
chmod +x score2.pcl
./score2.pcl "为什么草是绿的"

docs.title: 在 pi 会话内运行
docs.text:
装好连接器（pi install npm:pcl-connector-pi）后，不用离开对话：

/pcl run ./score.pcl "Why is the sky blue"

~/.pcl/bin/ 快捷命令——放进去的可执行 .pcl 自动变成斜杠命令：

mkdir -p ~/.pcl/bin && cp score.pcl ~/.pcl/bin/
chmod +x ~/.pcl/bin/score.pcl
# 重启 pi 后：/pcl-score "Why is the sky blue"

详见核心指南 · 与 pi 的两种集成。

docs.title: 设置
docs.text: 面向使用者。完整规则（信任模型、合并算法）：RFC 0001 §8。

docs.title: 两层配置
docs.text:
层 路径 说明 用户级 ~/.config/pcl/settings.json（或 $PCL_CONFIG_FILE） 你自己的环境 项目级 入口 .pcl 向上最近的 .pcl/settings.json 随仓库分发

优先级：命令行 > 项目级 > 用户级 > 内置默认。

格式是 JSONC（支持 // 注释与尾随逗号）。

docs.title: 常用配置
docs.text:
{
  // 使用哪个 agent 桥：pi / null / script
  "agent": "pi",
  // 单 pass 超时（秒）
  "timeout": 900,
  // 默认开 --trace
  "trace": false,
  "cache": {
    "disable": false,       // true = 每次重新编译
    "dir": null,            // 自定义缓存目录（相对路径按设置文件所在目录解析）
    "keep_per_stem": 2
  }
}

仅用户级可配（安全限制，项目级出现即报错）：

{
  "pi": {
    "bin": "/usr/local/bin/pi",      // pi 可执行
    "connector_path": "~/pi/pcl-connector/pi",  // 连接器路径
    "args": ["--model", "glm-5.3"]   // 透传参数（数组逐层拼接）
  },
  "script": { "path": "replay.jsonl" }
}

为什么限制？项目级文件是 clone 即得的不可信输入——若允许它指定 可执行/扩展路径，等于仓库静默执行任意代码。行为参数（agent/timeout/ trace/cache）项目级可配；执行面（pi.bin 等）仅用户级。

docs.title: 查看生效配置
docs.text:
pcl config            # 逐项打印值 + 来源（CLI/项目/用户/内置）
pcl config --defaults

docs.title: 环境变量
docs.text: 变量 作用 PCL_CONFIG_FILE 用户级设置重定向 PCL_NO_PROJECT_CONFIG 忽略项目级设置（密封运行） PCL_BIN 嵌入形态下连接器 spawn pcl 用
